body.name: Feasible-frame handle for the exact fixed-budget frontier
body.construction: Reduce the search for \(\rho_k(K,R)\) to positive-definite Schur complements \(H\) with spectrum in \([m,M]\), their normalized coordinate frame, and pairs of feasible hemisphere scores \((u_0,u_1)\) satisfying the residual-radius constraints; optimize the exact sum of singleton angular losses relative to the joint angular loss without replacing either by a global Lipschitz envelope.
